svg.title: Storage Scale System in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: 340 GB/s read and 155 GB/s write throughput for one Storage Scale System 6000, the 340 GB/s stated for NVMe over Fabrics configurations. 4.7 PB of raw capacity in one 4U node. More than 42 PB in a single 42U rack with All-Flash Expansion Enclosures.
